name: Accordion
description: Expandable question-and-answer list for FAQ blocks. Keyboard and screen-reader friendly.

name: Alert
description: Inline message for form results and important notices: info, success, warning, danger. Errors are announced to screen readers.

name: ArticleCard
description: Blog teaser: photo, category badge, date, title, excerpt and a read-more cue. The entire card is one link.

name: Avatar
description: Round portrait for staff, volunteers and quoted family members. Shows initials on a logo colour when there is no photo.

name: Badge
description: Small pill label for article categories, event status and 'new' markers. Soft, solid or outline in the logo colours.

name: Breadcrumbs
description: You-are-here trail at the top of inner pages, with direction-aware separators.

name: ButterflyDecor
description: The butterfly mark as a large decorative watermark for hero, banner and card backgrounds. Purely ornamental.

name: Button
description: Pill-shaped action button. Pink primary is reserved for the single most important action - usually donating.

name: CTABanner
description: Rounded call-to-action band that closes a page or interrupts a long one. Navy, pink gradient, sun or mint.

name: CampaignProgress
description: Fundraising thermometer: raised vs goal with a gradient bar, donor count, days left and a donate button.

name: Card
description: The base surface: a soft, generously rounded container (elevated, outlined, tinted or navy). Specialised cards build on it.

name: Checkbox
description: Checkbox with a large hit area for consents and multi-choice lists. The label may contain links.

name: ChipGroup
description: Tappable pill choices for interests, donation purposes and quick filters. Single- or multi-select.

name: ContactForm
description: Ready-made contact form: name, phone, e-mail, topic, message, consent - with labels, states and success / error messages.

name: Container
description: Centers content at the page width (narrow 760, default 1200, wide 1360) and adds the responsive side gutters.

name: Dialog
description: Modal window over a navy veil for donation thank-you, video player and confirmations. Closes on Escape and outside click.

name: Divider
description: Separates content: a quiet hairline, or four petal dots in the logo colours.

name: DocumentCard
description: Downloadable official document (proper-management certificate, section 46 approval, annual report) with a verified check.

name: DonationForm
description: The donation widget: monthly / one-time switch, preset amounts with a live impact line, custom amount, pink submit, secure note.

name: EventCard
description: Upcoming fun day, meet-up or fundraiser: coloured date tile, title, time, place, optional photo and status badge.

name: Eyebrow
description: Small bold label with a petal marker that sits above a heading and names the section.

name: FloatingContact
description: Always-reachable contact shortcuts: round WhatsApp and phone buttons pinned to a bottom corner of every page.

name: Gallery
description: Photo grid for events and activity days: equal tiles or a featured first photo. Tiles become buttons when onImageClick is set.

name: Grid
description: Responsive grid: up to N equal columns that collapse on their own as space runs out - no breakpoints needed.

name: Heading
description: Page and section titles in Polin Bold/Extrabold, h1-h6 with independent visual size. Combine with Highlight for key words.

name: Hero
description: Opening block of a page: big Polin headline, one paragraph, up to two buttons, and a photo in a petal frame with a perched butterfly. Split,

name: Highlight
description: Inline emphasis for one or two key words inside a Heading: marker stroke, drawn underline, or brand colour.

name: Icon
description: Line icon from the curated set (lucide outlines + WhatsApp, Facebook, Instagram, YouTube). Inherits text colour, arrows mirror in RTL.

name: IconButton
description: Round icon-only button for carousel arrows, close, menu toggle and social links. Always needs a label.

name: Logo
description: The Tikvat Libenu logo as crisp vector: full, compact, mark or wordmark - in colour, inverse (for dark surfaces) or mono.

name: Pagination
description: Page navigation for the blog and gallery archives: previous, numbered pages, next - direction-aware.

name: Paragraph
description: Body copy in Polin Regular: 18px with generous leading by default, tuned for long Hebrew text. Sizes lead, body, sm, xs.

name: Petal
description: A single soft petal shape from the butterfly logo - background decor only. Use it large and let a section edge crop it, never as loose spots

name: Picture
description: Photo frame with brand corner shapes and fixed ratios. Shows a branded butterfly placeholder when there is no src.

name: ProgressBar
description: Horizontal progress bar with a gradient fill (fills from the right in Hebrew) for fundraising goals and multi-step forms.

name: RadioGroup
description: One-of-many choice as plain radios or bordered cards, inside a fieldset with a legend.

name: Section
description: Full-width page band with brand background tones, consistent vertical rhythm and an inner Container.

name: SectionHeader
description: Standard opening of a page section: eyebrow, title, short description and an optional action at the far side.

name: SelectField
description: Native dropdown (best on phones and with screen readers) dressed in the brand field style.

name: ServiceCard
description: Describes one thing the amuta does: petal icon chip, title, short text, optional link. Rotate tones across a row.

name: SiteFooter
description: Navy page footer: full logo with tagline, mission line, link columns, contact details, social links and legal small print.

name: SiteHeader
description: The site's top bar: logo, main navigation and the pink donate button. Collapses into a menu panel when narrower than 960px.

name: Stack
description: Flex layout helper: stacks children in a column or row with a token-based gap.

name: Stat
description: One impact figure: a big Polin Black number with a short label and optional petal icon chip. Group several in a StatGroup.

name: StatGroup
description: Lays out a row of Stat figures - the impact-in-numbers strip. Plain, white card or navy band.

name: Steps
description: A short numbered sequence (horizontal or vertical timeline) with petal markers - how we accompany a family, how to donate.

name: Tabs
description: Switches between content panels, or filters a list by category (pills or underline). Arrow keys move between tabs.

name: TeamCard
description: Staff, board member or volunteer: portrait in a petal or circle frame, name, role, short bio.

name: TestimonialCard
description: A family's or volunteer's words: quote, name and role with avatar. Card, tinted or large centred feature variant.

name: TextField
description: Single-line text input with label, hint, error line and optional icon. E-mail, phone and URL values are typed left-to-right.

name: TextLink
description: Text hyperlink: inline inside copy, or a standalone read-more link with a direction-aware arrow.

name: TextareaField
description: Multi-line text input for messages and stories, with the same label / hint / error anatomy as TextField.

name: TikvatRoot
description: Page root: sets RTL direction, the Polin font, brand text colour and base resets. Wrap every page or fragment in it once.

name: VideoCard
description: Video teaser with a big round play button over the poster frame, duration chip and title. Landscape or vertical.
